== Strategy ==

card choice:

bad feeling have i (v) - this card was probably the reason that i returned to this objective: great card for this deck cause it allows me to get vader out quick. also pulls deep hatred, darth vaders lightsaber, maul strikes.

gall - pullable with mob points. cause a char just hit by blaster/blaster rifle to be lost

d*2 docking bay - needed for rise my friend

lord vader - i like the bonuses (weapon draws/defense value when armed, immune fury, power 7)

stormtrooper garrison - destiny/force drain bonus, power 8, prevents my leaders from being targeted; this is money

stormtrooper cadet - satisfy all attrition when forfeited at site with leader

dannik jerriko (v) - place any card of my choice out of play from oponents lost pile when present at battle i win

reegesk (v) - stealin machine

lathe - i think this card is way underused for its benefits. shuffle deck every turn, preventing tracking. also can eliminate large groups of non-unique aliens all at once

blaster rack - tempted to remove but i would like to pull all those weapons

imperial artillery - 7s always welcome. direct damage from my weapons

there is no conflict -

rise my friend - good for getting vader/luke to throne room to convert him

ommni box/its worse - if i keep lathe i will probably get rid of this because lathe can shuffle deck himself

mobilization points - starting effect when opponent doesn’t give me battlegrounds/force generation. no combo because more potential activation and can pull gall to get a battleground system

colo claw fish - starting when i dont need the extra activation from mobilization points. good card for getting good destiny

deep hatred - easier to beat wht/dotf with their own objective, stack those low destinys on vader to turn luke if you want, pullable with bfhi (v)
